Official T(2)=O(1), 2T(n/2)+O(1) is a correct asymptotic recurrence but not the exact comparison count; stored solution copies it. Steps agree (2T(n/2)+O(1); n-1 = 15 calls for n=16; O(n)). Rubric 2+2+1=5.

3a.note: 5 rotations confirmed by own AVL delete-min simulation on F10 (232 nodes, h=10): 5 rebalancing events, one at each of the 5 ancestors on the leftmost path; the bottom event is a double rotation when F1 hangs its child left (counted as one, matching the step) and single when right; all give 5 events. If a double were counted as 2 single rotations the answer would be 6 (so the stored 'double counts as one' wording in step 3 is needed). Leftmost path of F10 has 5 edges, balance -1 at every F_i, i>=2, height(F_i)=i. Rubric 1+2+1+1=5.
